data.text: Jack, I support the 10-ton plan. Luke, I won’t ask our neighbors to race you to empty the lake. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and our village depends on us doing that. Ten tons each means $10,000 apiece this month and the same opportunity next month; draining the lake ends everyone’s livelihood. Let’s agree on a combined limit of 50 tons, split equally, and review the revealed catches together each month. Luke, will you withdraw your demand and commit to your 10-ton share?
